target.scope: Static original Win64 native code, matching PDB; portable Mac reconstruction probes are separate observations.

load_callbacks.source_filter: No mTriggerNames -> run; otherwise exact map-name membership in trigger names vector. Numeric trigger IDs are not consulted by Map::Begin.
load_callbacks.arguments: Fresh global_triggerArgs table; nonempty map name writes name. No source Thing: no triggeredById or TriggeredByTable.
load_callbacks.dispatch: OnAnyLoad uses Script::ProtectedRun -> Lua::ProtectedCallVoid with cached RUN_SCRIPT (original dispatch), registered callback and args. OnLoad uses Script::run and same dispatch. Callback may schedule/yield original coroutines; finishing its initial resume is not finishing its asynchronous work.
load_callbacks.failure: ProtectedRun false returns false immediately from Map::Begin; native World::Start creates corrupt-save error flow. ProtectedRun also has a global script-disabled guard, not reconstructed by portable probe. Lua dispatch/resume itself can handle coroutine errors, so native protected-call success alone is not proof of full callback completion.

map_activation.top_level_gate: For each GroupManager::GetAllThings record: AttachToID>0 is skipped by top-level creation; children created through World::CreateChildren after parent. Active=false outside EditingMode goes to inactive map. Active=true with ActivateAtRange=false creates directly. ActivateAtRange=true requires first valid player, world.mFrame>1 and within ActivationRange; otherwise inactive map + GridManager::RegisterInactiveMapThing.
map_activation.do_create_boundary: Decoded serialized DoCreate is not a MapThingDef PDB member. Loader-level DoCreate processing was not recovered in this pass; the portable staging retains it separately. Do not equate it to fully reconstructed native activation.
unknowns: Initial world frame/player state at all native load paths
Actual allocations/components/OnSpawn side effects for original map records
Attachment recursion and range activation update loop

on_spawn.source_filter: Script::isSource accepts unfiltered callbacks; otherwise any matching original map ID, group membership, virtual GetName type-name, or category token _UNIT/_OBSTACLE. Native enum category and type-name are different filters.
on_spawn.gate: Thing.pThingData->mDef.mTriggerOnSpawn at ThingDataDef0x368 (ThingData+0x370) must be true. Caller can also suppress dispatch. ObstacleManager::Add tests caller boolean then passes NeedsLuaInitialization=false.

arguments.all_matching: NeedsLuaInitialization boolean from caller, name=Thing virtual GetName; Script::run supplies triggeredById and TriggeredByTable
arguments.units_only: SpawnedById=Unit.mSpawnedBy; PlayerIndex only when Unit.pPlayer exists, from Player+8. UnitManager caller boolean not traced in this pass.

portable_text.actual_original_path: UIScripts.lua42 OnAnyLoad iterates original TextFormats, SpawnObstacle BlankObstacle, writes Name/Id/AutoSetDataProperties=true, CreateTextBox.
portable_text.native_contract: CreateTextBox resolves real active Thing ID, creates/attaches TextComponent when absent, allocates TextSystem GUIComponentTextBox, appends component to owner. AutoSetDataProperties reflects table properties before explicit Font/FontSize/color/layout reads; bridge returns void. Empty Text/RawText still creates component.
portable_text.implemented: VM-owned named empty formatting components attached to existing active object IDs; exact explicit source property values copied by type and numeric array; native FontSize integer conversion recorded separately; multiple calls append distinct records. Owner activity reflected by snapshots.
limitations: Nonempty Text/RawText fails explicitly: localization, token graft evaluation, font defaults/layout, glyph drawing are not reconstructed.
Missing properties stay absent; component compiled defaults and effective color/property precedence are not fabricated.
Unsupported argument/action cases fail explicitly; no DestroyTextBox/ModifyTextBox implementation claimed.
Component sequence is reconstruction-local identity, not original pooled handle.

sources: exact original UIScripts OnAnyLoad formatting callback
original_callback_result.scope: Isolated formatting smoke left GameState unset to avoid unrelated shrine updates; production parent host ran full GameState and proceeded.

contract: Fresh global IdsTable is also returned as dense 1-based array.
Processes singular Name then each Names array entry; duplicates across selected groups preserved. No implicit descendant group traversal.
Membership comes from active map Thing sets; no RequireAlive parameter read by native GetIds. Portable alive flag currently means undestroyed object, not health.

Optional Type is exact case-sensitive virtual Thing::GetName string, not Unit/Obstacle enum. Obstacle+0x88 vtable slot -> RVA0x2c55a0 returns Obstacle.mName0x588; Unit slot -> RVA0x69620 returns Unit.pData+8 name string.

Unknown/empty group name GetIndex=-1 resolves native MapThingGroupId::None; missing set returns shared EmptyThingSet. Portable reconstruction uses empty membership name for None; RoomOpening has no None members.

get_ids.portable_state: All ObjectSnapshot.groups memberships queried; group retained as primary/fallback for old metadata. Runtime SpawnObstacle fills groups with its actual auto-created scene group. Seed order retained, runtime objects appended.
get_ids.ordering_limit: Native enumerates pointer-hash bucket order. Portable queries explicitly use metadata insertion order within each selected group, not original allocation-dependent native ordering. Later random choice/order-dependent Lua may differ.
get_ids.phase_limit: This queries loaded metadata state in load-callback probe, not proven full native map activation.
get_ids.focused_check: ASan/UBSan debugger verifies insertion order, secondary membership, inactive exclusion, repeated groups duplicate results, exact type-name filter, unknown group empty in this scene, IdsTable alias.
